“The car can recharge its air tank, so it’s not like you, you know need special propellant or anything like that, it literally is just going to pop itself up, and be able to do these maneuvers whenever you’d like.”
No way. It’s not going to recharge itself. It’s not, and I’ll prove it. But if I just so happen to be wrong, I’ll do a JCPenney photo shoot, completely decked out in Tesla swag, and photos go public. Honestly I couldn’t believe JCPenny was still doing this. Anyways, if I’m right, and I am, I win the respect. To some people that’s more important.
